command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

RV=$(rsem-calculate-expression --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $NF}')
echo "== EM over every alignment, not just the unambiguous ones =="
samtools view -bS aln.sam > aln.bam            # bowtie2's image has no samtools; this one does
test -s aln.bam || { echo "conversion produced an empty BAM"; exit 1; }
rsem-calculate-expression --alignments --no-bam-output -p 2 aln.bam idx out > calc.log 2>&1 \
  || { tail -20 calc.log; exit 1; }
cat out.isoforms.results

read -r CA EA TA < <(awk -F'\t' '$1=="txA"{print $5, $4, $6}' out.isoforms.results)
read -r CB EB TB < <(awk -F'\t' '$1=="txB"{print $5, $4, $6}' out.isoforms.results)
PA=$(awk '$1=="txA"{print $2}' truth.tsv); PB=$(awk '$1=="txB"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
NREADS=$(awk -v a="$PA" -v b="$PB" 'BEGIN{print a+b}')

echo "== identity 1: EM redistributes reads, so the counts must sum to the reads =="
awk -v a="$CA" -v b="$CB" -v n="$NREADS" 'BEGIN{ s=a+b
  if (s-n > 0.01 || n-s > 0.01) { printf "sum(expected_count)=%.2f != %d reads\n", s, n; exit 1 }
  printf "  sum expected_count = %.2f == %d reads\n", s, n }'

echo "== identity 2: TPM is a per-million share, so it must sum to 1e6 =="
awk -v a="$TA" -v b="$TB" 'BEGIN{ s=a+b
  if (s-1000000 > 1 || 1000000-s > 1) { printf "sum(TPM)=%.2f != 1e6\n", s; exit 1 }
  printf "  sum TPM = %.2f\n", s }'

echo "== the recovered read ratio, against the planted one =="
RATIO=$(awk -v a="$CA" -v b="$CB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", a/b}')
PRATIO=$(awk -v a="$PA" -v b="$PB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", a/b}')
awk -v r="$RATIO" -v p="$PRATIO" 'BEGIN{ d=(r>p)?r-p:p-r
  if (d/p > 0.02) { printf "recovered ratio %.4f differs from planted %.4f by more than 2%%\n", r, p; exit 1 }
  printf "  recovered %.4f vs planted %.4f\n", r, p }'

echo "== identity 3: why the TPM ratio is NOT the read ratio =="
TRATIO=$(awk -v a="$TA" -v b="$TB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", a/b}')
PRED=$(awk -v r="$RATIO" -v ea="$EA" -v eb="$EB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", r*(eb/ea)}')
awk -v t="$TRATIO" -v p="$PRED" 'BEGIN{ d=(t>p)?t-p:p-t
  if (d > 0.005) { printf "TPM ratio %.4f != count ratio x eff-length ratio %.4f\n", t, p; exit 1 }
  printf "  TPM ratio %.4f == count ratio x (effB/effA) = %.4f  -- EXACT\n", t, p }'

echo "== the naive method, for contrast =="
NA=$(awk '$1=="txA"{print $2}' naive_unique.tsv); NB=$(awk '$1=="txB"{print $2}' naive_unique.tsv)
NRATIO=$(awk -v a="$NA" -v b="$NB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", a/b}')
# The planted answer says txA is the more abundant. The naive answer must put it BELOW txB --
# not merely off, but on the wrong side of 1. That is the claim worth asserting.
awk -v n="$NRATIO" -v p="$PRATIO" 'BEGIN{
  if (!(p > 1 && n < 1)) { printf "naive ratio %.4f and planted %.4f are on the same side of 1\n", n, p; exit 1 }
  printf "  naive %.4f < 1 < %.4f planted -- the ORDER is inverted\n", n, p }'

{
printf 'RSEM -- EM over multi-mapping reads, and what unique-only counting does instead\n'
printf 'rsem_version\t%s\n' "$RV"
printf 'planted\ttxA %s / txB %s reads   ratio %s\n' "$PA" "$PB" "$PRATIO"
printf 'expected_count\ttxA %s / txB %s   ratio %s   (assert within 2%% of planted)\n' "$CA" "$CB" "$RATIO"
printf 'count_conservation\t%s   (assert == %s reads -- EM redistributes, it does not create)\n' "$(awk -v a="$CA" -v b="$CB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", a+b}')" "$NREADS"
printf 'tpm_conservation\t%s   (assert == 1000000 -- EXACT)\n' "$(awk -v a="$TA" -v b="$TB" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", a+b}')"
printf 'tpm_ratio\t%s   (NOT the read ratio -- it equals count_ratio x effB/effA = %s, EXACT)\n' "$TRATIO" "$PRED"
printf 'effective_lengths\ttxA %s / txB %s   (from lengths 900 / 1600)\n' "$EA" "$EB"
printf 'naive_unique_only\ttxA %s / txB %s   ratio %s   (assert < 1 while planted > 1)\n' "$NA" "$NB" "$NRATIO"
printf 'note\tunique-only counting does not merely mis-estimate here -- it INVERTS the order,\n'
printf 'note\treporting txB as the more abundant when txA has three times the reads. txB has 800 bp\n'
printf 'note\tof uniquely-mappable sequence against txAs 100 bp, so it collects unique reads far\n'
printf 'note\tout of proportion to its abundance. That bias is what EM exists to remove.\n'
printf 'note\tAnd comparing TPM against a planted READ ratio would look like a 5.7-vs-3.0 failure:\n'
printf 'note\tTPM is length-normalised, so the two differ by exactly the effective-length ratio.\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
